steps.en: Start a self-hosted n8n with the Docker install script
steps.zh: 用 Docker 安装脚本启动一套自托管 n8n

steps.en: Open the editor; chain a trigger node to connector nodes, add a Code node where none fits
steps.zh: 打开编辑器，把触发节点连到连接器节点，缺的地方补 Code 节点

steps.en: Handles each service's auth, pagination and API calls inside its node
steps.zh: 在节点内部替你处理各服务的认证、分页和 API 调用

steps.en: Publish the workflow so the saved version goes live
steps.zh: 点 Publish，让保存的版本上线

steps.en: On every trigger, passes JSON items node to node; Code nodes run in a sandboxed task runner
steps.zh: 每次触发逐节点传递 JSON 条目，Code 节点进沙箱运行

steps.en: Stores every execution with each node's input and output for inspection and retry
steps.zh: 保存每次执行及各节点的输入输出，供排查和重试

value.en: SaaS-to-SaaS glue lives on one self-hosted canvas that non-engineers can read, with code only where needed
value.zh: SaaS 之间的胶水集中在一张自托管画布上，非工程师也看得懂，只在需要时写代码

sources: n8n-io/n8n README.md (master, retrieved 2026-10-08): Quick Start — curl -fsSL https://get.n8n.io | sh; Access the editor at http://localhost:5678; 1500+ integrations

n8n-io/n8n-docs docs/changelog/v20-breaking-changes.md (retrieved 2026-10-08): Publish/Unpublish replaces Activate; task runners enabled by default; Python Code node needs external-mode runners (n8nio/runners)
